# permio_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by name (or by ID). Use its `id` in `permio_grant.roles`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a role created outside Terraform and grant it by ID.
data "permio_role" "admin" {
  name = "Workspace admin"
}

resource "permio_grant" "alice" {
  principal = "user_alice"
  resource  = "/workspaces/acme"
  roles     = [data.permio_role.admin.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Role ID. Set either `name` or `id`.
- `name` (String) Exact role name. Set either `name` or `id`.
- `project` (String) Project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Names of the role's permissions.
